lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Debt securities
lines.why: Bonds held for sale or to maturity: financial.

lines.name: Loans, net of the allowance
lines.why: Lending is a bank's business: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deposits
lines.why: Customers' money a bank holds is its business: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

We rely on third-party service providers for significant components of our business operations, including core data processing systems, payment processing, cybersecurity monitoring, and other critical functions.
In particular, our operations rely on the secure processing, storage and transmission of confidential and other information on our technology systems and networks.
In determining the size of the allowance for credit losses, we rely on our experience and our evaluation of current economic conditions.

These net gains primarily depend on the volume of loans we sell, which in turn depends on our ability to originate real estate mortgage loans and the demand for fixed-rate obligations and other loans that are outside of our established interest-rate risk parameters.
Our parent company must rely on dividends or returns of capital from our bank for most of its cash flow.
These dividends or returns of capital are the principal source of funds to pay our parent company’s operating expenses and for cash dividends on our common stock.
